Topic 3.6: Letter READING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Letter READING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which contain various materials on letters, e.g. recognition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Match upper case letters with corresponding lower case letters in class.
2. Take pleasure in letter matching activities in and out of class. and upper case letters. poems and rhymes related to letter recognition while displaying letters. be engaged in activities related to letter recognition games e.g. letter fishing games, letter sorting trays, letter basket balls, letter hunting games among others. competition games. Encourage fairness in winning and acceptance in losing. 29 letter recognition. Core-competence developed: Learning to learn, digital literacy, communication and collaboration.
